name: Kinukawa Ayuka
source:
A second year-student, the protagonist's childhood friend, and a member of the health committee. 

She is very plain in appearance, but has big breasts.
She can't make decisions on her own and is easily influenced.
Whenever there is a problem, she gets nervous about how to handle it.
